subject: E-4133: token rejected on macOS
body:
Hi, I'm using PixelForge 6.0.4 on macOS 14.7. Since the weekend, every time I open the app, I get 'E-4133: authentication token rejected'.

The failure is specific to the office network, the hotspot is fine. Our IT rolled out a new proxy to every desk this month.

What I tried so far: waiting a day. No luck.

Sofia Rossi - Ferro & Sons. Appreciate any pointers.
